title: E. coli heat shock transformation with SOC recovery

containers.name: plasmid_plate
containers.description: Source plate holding plasmid DNA stocks (one per well)

containers.name: cells_rack
containers.description: 50 µL competent E. coli aliquots on ice, one tube per transformation

containers.name: soc_reservoir
containers.description: SOC medium pre-warmed to room temperature

steps.source_quote: add 2 µL plasmid DNA per tube
steps.note: Gently flick to mix after addition — no vortex; fresh tip per tube to avoid cross-contamination

steps.action: Heat shock cells_rack 42°C 45 s, then transfer immediately to ice 2 min
steps.note: OT-2 cannot perform heat shock; robot pauses and operator moves tubes to water bath, then back to deck

steps.source_quote: add 250 µL SOC medium to each tube
steps.note: Single multi-aspiration from reservoir; dispense slowly to avoid disturbing pellet

steps.action: Incubate cells_rack 37°C 60 min at 250 rpm for outgrowth recovery
steps.note: Recovery duration assumed 60 min — standard practice; not stated in NL input

assumptions: plasmid_wells=column_1 — layout not stated; first column of plasmid_plate assumed
cells_rack_positions=A1:D3 — 12 tubes assumed; exact positions not given
no_mix_after_dna_addition — gently flick only; vortexing kills competent cells
soc_volume=250 µL — standard NEB heat shock protocol; not stated in NL
recovery_time=60 min at 37°C 250 rpm — standard; not stated in NL
fresh_tip_per_tube — assumed to prevent cross-contamination between constructs
